name: Black-browed albatross
desc: The Falklands hold the largest breeding population in the world. It eats fish, squid, crustaceans, carrion and fishery discards.
about: The black-browed albatross, also known as the black-browed mollymawk, is a large seabird of the albatross family Diomedeidae; it is the most widespread and common member of its family.
